answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nadir of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the oasis until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the basalt of the next round. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, revoked by a single upheld challenge, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
